chunks: And ʿAmmār al-Sābāṭī narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
“Most of the people of Paradise are weak women. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, knew their weakness, so He had mercy on them.”

key_terms.أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ: the people or inhabitants of Paradise

ai.seo_question: Why does this hadith say that many of the people of Paradise are weak women?
ai.summary: This hadith states that many of the inhabitants of Paradise will be women among the weak and vulnerable. It attributes this to Allah’s knowledge of their weakness and His mercy toward them, highlighting divine mercy and the reward of the oppressed or disadvantaged.
